description: Search podcasts in the OndaCast catalogue by title or topic, with an optional language filter. Returns up to `limit` shows with an OndaCast page link. When OndaCast has no match, it may list shows from a public podcast directory that are not on OndaCast yet; the add_podcast tool can add one.

language.description: Language, as shown in OndaCast's filters.

query.description: Podcast title or words to search for.

name: search_podcasts
title: Search podcasts
